title: Set 4  My New Schoolbag
subtitle: 对应课本：Unit 2 My schoolbag

dialogue.t: Look! I have a new schoolbag. It's blue and white.
I have a Chinese book, a notebook and a toy car.
Yes, I do. I have two storybooks. Do you want to read one?
Yes, please! Here's some candy for you.

vocab: new 新的 · schoolbag 书包 · Chinese book 语文书 · notebook 笔记本 · toy car 玩具车 · storybook 故事书 · candy 糖果

sections.title: A. 判断对错（T 对，F 错）
